ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (27) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Самосовершенствование» (samosovershenstvovaniye) and Mallory's «самоусовершенствование» (samousovershenstvovaniye) are both 'self-perfection', and Confucius' «совершенствование» (sovershenstvovaniye) is 'perfecting', keeping the root of «совершенство» (sovershenstvo, 'perfection'); «улучшение» (uluchsheniye) stays 'improvement'. The Gospel saying is translated from Tolstoy's Russian with lowercase 'father' as printed, and generic «человек» (chelovek, 'person') keeps 'he'.
Source observation: [23] Stray comma in «потому что она, противна тем…» ('because it, is contrary to those…'), apparently a transcription slip; translated as if absent.
